purpose: Verifies that ADR-009 (candidate SQL persistence) and V2-P00R §6 (result fingerprints) now hold for both evaluation writers.

canonicalization_contract.numeric_representation: Decimal.normalize (trailing zeros stripped; integer form for integral values)

shared_result_fingerprint_utility.tests: tests/unit/benchmark/test_result_fingerprint.py (8 tests: determinism, cross-shape parity, duplicate preservation, order sensitivity, NULL/bool normalization, numeric normalization, empty-result stability, in-row column-order sensitivity)

writers.inference_before_gold_ordering: PASS — candidate fingerprint is computed before gold is loaded (see runner.py::_run_case)

writers.candidate_sql_field: generated_sql (added by V2-P00R; the historical boolean generated_sql_present is retained for backward compatibility with existing aggregate readers)
writers.inference_before_gold_ordering: PASS — candidate fingerprint and inference artifacts are finalized before execute_gold_sql is invoked (see run_p1_experiment.py::_run_case)
writers.note: The P1 experiment runner remains an untracked user file that V2-P00R was explicitly authorized to modify to bring it into ADR-009 compliance. It still lives under scripts/evaluation/; siting is not a Tier-1 blocker.

gold_isolation_invariant.invariant: Gold data must not influence inference. It is loaded only after runtime_result is materialized and the candidate result fingerprint has been computed.
verification: Guard 3 and Guard 4 (production → evaluation import boundary) continue to pass on both the clean baseline and the workspace.
Guard 5 (production DTOs reject gold_* fields) continues to pass.
Both benchmark and P1 runners compute candidate_result_fingerprint BEFORE calling execute_gold_sql; gold fingerprint is computed AFTER.

residual_gaps.issue: Full grounded context text still not persisted; only counts + serialized_context_chars are recorded. Adding a context_hash keyed off the serialized S0/S1/S2/S3 output would let auditors reconstruct the exact prompt input.

Raw candidate/gold rows are not persisted; only fingerprints. This is intentional (privacy) but means A-F semantic auditing still requires re-executing the SQL. Sample-rows-with-fingerprint is a future consideration governed by data-handling policy.
